meaning:
1) to part, open wide
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to open wide
1a2) to be talkative (of the mouth)
1b) (Piel) to open wide

elsewhere.note: He who guards his mouth guards his soul. One who opens wide his lips comes to ruin.
You have built your lofty place at the head of every way, and have made your beauty an abomination, and have opened your feet to everyone who passed by, and…
